en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a large brick church with wooden ceiling beams, chandeliers, and long rows of pews leading up to an altar with a cross. The photograph is taken from the central aisle looking toward the chancel. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location as the interior of Masthuggskyrkan in Göteborg. A round logo in the lower right credits the photographer/publisher Axel Eliassons Konstförlag in Stockholm.
